headline: test11 kept ONE uniform claim shape (affine bijection; 4 claims = {integer,LP} x {forward,reverse}) but the reverse claim had to discharge two edit kinds in four different obligation shapes; the edit semantics themselves never reached the kernel - they arrived as the analysis agent's 10,001,987-byte audit.json, from which an 86-line preparer assembled 1,123,132 obligations / 41,081,450 B of RPA.
uniform_edit_shape_finding: A single uniform edit shape was sufficient at the CLAIM layer but not at the OBLIGATION layer, and this case shows where the boundary lies. Claim layer: unchanged and uniform - request.json holds only {reverse,input_integers,output_integers,objective:'Equal',projection:40488 pairs,inverse:<claim index>} (tools/prepare_test11.py:60), so both edit kinds (22,041 alias eliminations plus their 8,559-row redundancy removal = 6,543 bound-implied + 2,016 dominance) ride one affine-bijection claim shape, and the request carries no edit list, no removed-row names and no witnesses. Obligation layer: the reverse claim discharges the 30,600 removed source rows in FOUR shapes - 22,041 alias-defining equalities as the literal string 'Exact' (substitution collapses them to 0=0), 6,543 bound-implied rows as 3,208 bare VarLower + 3,208 bare VarUpper refs (single-bound rows) + 89 Lin facts over variable bounds + 38 'Exact', and 2,016 dominance rows as Lin facts whose terms are the retained witness row plus explicitly nonnegative VarLower multipliers; the 90,561 retained rows are direct refs. Evidence: cases/test11/proof.rpa blocks[1].end.Return.checks (305,155 entries), generated by tools/prepare_test11.py:38-46. Consequence: what this case needed beyond one edit shape is (a) a per-removed-row reason+witness record (EDIT_AUDIT), (b) a planner that picks and reuses the cheapest discharge per (direction,row) (CLAIM_PLANNING), and (c) typed constructors for the three row rules with sense normalisation and unbounded-support screening (RULE_BUILDERS).
claims: 4 claims, one shape: {reverse,input_integers,output_integers,objective:'Equal',projection,inverse}; claims 0/1 are integer (forward/reverse) and 2/3 LP, with inverse wired positionally as [1,0,3,2] (tools/prepare_test11.py:60, cases/test11/request.json).

Forward claim obligations (source->target, integer): 62,832 variable-bound checks (40,488 VarLower + 22,344 VarUpper) + 9,072 VarInt + 90,561 rows (72,744 direct Row refs, 17,817 Lin substitution facts) + 40,488 projection 'Exact' + 62,529 inverse obligations = 265,483 checks and 39,858 Lin steps (26,889 of them carrying RowEq alias-witness terms, 160,856 RowEq refs in total; 80,977 'Exact' strings).

Reverse claim obligations (target->source, integer): 93,945 bound checks + 9,072 VarInt + 121,161 rows (90,561 direct refs; 22,041 'Exact'; 6,543 bound rows = 3,208 VarLower refs + 3,208 VarUpper refs + 89 Lin + 38 'Exact'; 2,016 dominance Lin) + 1 + 40,488 projection + 40,488 inverse = 305,155 checks and 2,105 Lin steps (all kind Le, max 10 terms).
LP variants are the same blocks minus the 9,072 VarInt checks: 256,411 (forward) and 296,083 (reverse); step counts identical (39,858 / 2,105), every step is Lin, statistics.branches = 0.
Kernel receipt: 1,123,132 obligations, 13,004,302 work, peak_live_facts 39,858, execute 2.216 s, RPX 27,215,640 B; all four hand-made mutations INVALID (cases/test11/preparation.json).
proof_encoding: RPA v2, one part: 'RPA 2\n' + {claims,blocks}; each block ends in {'Return':{'map':[40,488 | 62,529 affine expressions],'checks':[...]}} (tools/prepare_test11.py:60-61).

checks mixes bare refs ({'VarLower':i},{'VarUpper':i},{'VarInt':i},{'RowLower':i},{'RowUpper':i},{'RowEq':i},{'Local':i}) with the literal string 'Exact' - 80,977 'Exact' in the forward claim, 103,056 in the reverse.

Witness data is inlined as multipliers, never as an edit record: forward substitution steps carry RowEq refs; reverse dominance steps carry a RowUpper witness plus nonneg VarLower multipliers (e.g. [{'RowUpper':1514},1] plus VarLower terms); the 89 box steps carry VarLower/VarUpper activity terms.

projection is materialised inside the claims: 4 x 40,488 pairs = 2,178,452 of the 2,178,892 request bytes (378 bytes are not projection), and proof.rpa repeats the same lists; the forward and reverse maps are mutual inverses with 18,155 non-identity pairs out of 40,488.

'Exact' as an obligation value means the substituted expression vanished identically (kind Eq, constant 0) or a Le-normalised row is <= 0 with no terms - the edit's justification is the substitution itself, not a cited row.
agent_manual_work: Streamed the 40,218,798-byte source twice with exact Fraction(Decimal(token)) parsing, discovered exactly 22,041 homogeneous two-term equalities (+1/-1) and cut them into equality-connected components (sizes 2..6, 12 distinct family signatures) with its own union-find.

Chose representatives by a priority map {B:0,Bga:1,Bgp:1}, intersected component domains (max lower, min upper), propagated integrality, and asserted the surviving domains equal the original representatives' domains.

Re-derived every substituted row's exact min/max activity over the retained bounds: 6,543 bound-implied removals and 0 contradictions; matched all 2,016 CondBgp rows to paired SoloArrOpNPar1 witnesses with explicitly nonnegative extra terms; found 0 duplicate rows.

Killed a plausible extra edit with a local counter-argument: all 45,360 cost facets got exact strict-activity witnesses inside their linked B=1 interval (min margin 127359/781250000), so all were retained.

Wrote the reduced MPS by hand (17,074,363 B) with its own exact-decimal writer, re-audited it with a second independent parser, and emitted the 10,001,987-byte audit.json carrying the edit list, all witnesses and the investigation results - all in eval cells, with no kernel construction API available.
preparer_helpers: tools/prepare_test11.py is 86 lines and imports from five sibling preparers: parse_mps/row_ref (prepare_affine.py:20,77), expression/plus/mul/expr_json/row_fact/sha (prepare_test40.py:72-90), substitute (prepare_test57.py:11), fact/box/exact (prepare_test54.py:16-33), SparseBuilder (prepare_test70.py:14) extending Builder (prepare_test88.py:16).

:15 rebuilds the alias map from audit['edits']['eliminated_variables'] by name->index; :21-24 re-scans each alias row to build a (row_ref, 1/c) witness table under a normalisation assert; :25 asserts the target's deleted-row set equals the union of the three hand-supplied edit categories.

:38-46 is the entire discharge plan: retained row -> row_ref; exact(kind,wanted) -> 'Exact'; bound_redundancy_certificates -> box(); otherwise nonnegative_dominance_certificates -> Lin fact over the witness row plus VarLower terms.

box() (prepare_test54.py:26-33) computes one direction's activity, asserts every support variable has a finite bound, and asserts the Le-normalised ceiling <= 0 - sense normalisation and screen-out of infinite bounds stay with the caller.
Emission is string assembly (:66): 'RPA 2\n' + compact JSON, request = json.dumps(cert['claims']); the four negative certificates are hand-mutated by positional surgery (:74-82).
friction: The edit ledger never reaches the kernel: the request carries no edit list, the alias map exists only as Return.map expressions, and every box/dominance witness is reconstructed from an untrusted 10,001,987-byte audit.json read as h['edits'].

Dispatch is by membership tests on three hand-supplied name sets, with a bare else that assumes dominance (tools/prepare_test11.py:38-46); a row that is none of retained/exact/box/dominance would be silently misproved rather than rejected.

The same semantic obligation becomes 'Exact', a bare bound ref or a Lin step depending on incidental ref identity in fact()/box() (prepare_test54.py:20-33), so obligation counts and shapes vary with normalisation rather than with the mathematics.

Failure attribution is prose: all four mutations returned exactly {"status":"INVALID","message":"INVALID obligation mismatch: expected Le; obligation 71908"} - an index into a 305,155-entry list, with no claim id, rule or row name.

Artifact cost is dominated by repetition: 2 distinct directions are written 4 times each (41,081,450 B RPA / 2,178,892 B request), the 40,488-pair map appears 4x in the request and 4x again inside proof.rpa, and the integer/LP blocks differ only by 9,072 VarInt checks.
